title: Studio validation preview: a state machine row's '' (may be cleared) target shows as a trailing separator or a blank
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As6kDA9BVrMsBR9rmrJ

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · found by the #36567 dev (os-dev-report comment 7103741576 on #36567), outside that card's surface. Pre-existing on main.

## What happens
`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ValidationPreview.tsx:298` (main) renders a state's targets as `tos.join(' | ')`, or the dead-end text when the list is empty. Since PR #36127 a `''` target means "this state may be cleared". A rule with `transitions: { paused: ['open', ''], closed: [''] }` previews as `paused → open | ` (a trailing separator) and `closed → ` (a blank), so the preview neither says "may be cleared" nor reads as a dead end.

## Done when
- The preview names a `''` target as "may be cleared" (localised, en and zh), and a row whose only target is `''` does not read as blank.
- A pin renders the rule above and asserts both rows' text; one ablation.

reach: the metadata-admin validation preview of a state_machine rule (preview registry), measured in a test render (row texts `pausedopen | ` and `closed`); not yet in a browser.
Business reason: an admin reviewing a state machine in Studio misreads a clearable state as a broken or empty row, right after Studio gained the control to author it (PR #36719).
Reader: the o7-studio area of seat repo:objectstack#7 (metadata-admin previews).
Dedupe: `ValidationPreview state_machine` → 1 (#36567, the parent); `ValidationPreview transitions` → 1 (#36567).
Suggested-grade: p3 · area:build · Bug · builders, sometimes (display only; the rule saves and enforces correctly) · measured in a test render.
